deal_summary: The buyer tested its packaging on the equipment, iterated on the configuration and price, agreed to a 70/30 payment structure, and exchanged contract and invoice documents. At the last retained event, the buyer said the 70% payment was expected that day or the next; payment is not confirmed in this view. [evidence: 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12]

customer_need.summary: A labeling machine for cylindrical packaging, configured to the buyer's product and line. The buyer requested a feed table, conveyor extensions, and a mirrored applicator. A manager worklog says the approximate 700k price was acceptable, but the buyer does not directly confirm that amount here. [evidence: 0, 2, 3, 6, 7]

deal_dynamics.early: The buyer asked to visit the factory and test the equipment with its product; the manager coordinated a date and preparation. [evidence: 1, 2]
deal_dynamics.middle: After the visit, the buyer requested itemized base and option prices, refined the requested configuration, and proposed staged payments. The parties agreed to 70/30 and clarified technical specifications. [evidence: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
deal_dynamics.late: The buyer's director wanted drawings or an example; the manager sent a comparable project video. The buyer reported the contract was signed and being scanned, supplied documents in chat, and said 70% would be paid that day or the next. The view ends without payment confirmation. [evidence: 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]

evidence.paraphrase: Manager worklog says buyer requested packaging/label dimensions, expected near-term purchase, had production, and accepted a price from 700k; this is a manager claim.
Buyer asked to visit the factory to see the equipment; possible dates were discussed.
Buyer confirmed the visit was for a test run with cylindrical packaging; manager scheduled and prepared it.
After visiting, buyer requested prices for the base machine and options including a feed table, conveyor extension, and mirrored applicator.
Buyer proposed 60% upfront, 30% after manufacture/testing, and 10% after commissioning at the buyer's site.
Manager explained the usual 70/30 structure and testing sequence; buyer agreed to 70/30.
Buyer said the test run went well and confirmed the applicator should be mirrored; manager requested company details and a specification form.
They clarified label/container dimensions, feed-table direction, conveyor, and applicator size; buyer preferred the standard winding unit over the more expensive larger option.
Buyer said the director wanted drawings or an example before signing; manager agreed to request archival material.
Buyer said signature would be the next day; manager said he would reserve a September production slot on his own responsibility before signature and payment.
Buyer said all parties had signed the contract and it was being scanned.
Manager said the received documents were being passed to accounting.
Buyer said 70% would be paid that day or the next; this is an intention, not payment confirmation.

uncertainties: The approximate 700k price acceptance is recorded by a manager, not directly confirmed by the customer. [evidence: 0]
The final amount/configuration is not shown as one customer-confirmed offer. [evidence: 3, 6, 7]
No payment confirmation or later event appears after the customer's stated payment timing. [evidence: 12]
